transactions.desc: The Diamondbacks reinstated Burnes (elbow) from the 60-day injured list to start Tuesday's game against the Royals.
The Rays designated Bigge for assignment Tuesday.
The Rays selected Madrigal's contract from Triple-A Durham on Tuesday, Ryan Bass of Rays.tv reports.
The Yankees designated Hampton for assignment Monday.
The Yankees activated Judge (ribs) from the 60-day injured list Monday.
The Dodgers recalled Sheehan from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Monday.
The Dodgers optioned Miller to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Monday.
The Rangers optioned Peoples to Triple-A Round Rock on Monday.
The Rangers activated Garcia (shoulder) from the 60-day injured list Monday.
The Giants recalled Abner from Triple-A Sacramento on Monday.
The Giants optioned Roxby to Triple-A Sacramento on Monday.
The Reds optioned Arroyo to Triple-A Louisville on Monday.
The Reds activated Hayes (groin) from the 10-day injured list Monday.
The White Sox activated Murphy (forearm) from the 15-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Charlotte on Monday.
The Nationals recalled Cruz from Triple-A Rochester on Monday.
The Padres designated Hunt for assignment Monday.
The Padres optioned Brito to Triple-A El Paso on Monday.
The Padres activated Pivetta (forearm) from the 60-day injured list Monday.
The Rockies optioned Ritter to Triple-A Albuquerque on Monday.
The Rockies activated Karros (concussion) from the 7-day injured list Monday.
The Brewers recalled Sproat from Triple-A Nashville on Monday, Adam McCalvy of MLB.com reports.
The Mets optioned Hagenman to Triple-A Syracuse on Monday.
The Mets recalled Tong from Triple-A Syracuse on Monday.
The Twins optioned Acton to Triple-A St. Paul on Monday.
The Twins activated Ryan (glute) from the 15-day injured list Monday.
The Yankees optioned Rodriguez to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre following Sunday's 4-3 loss to the Padres.
The Dodgers recalled Alfonzo from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Sunday.
The Astros optioned Meyers to Triple-A Sugar Land on Sunday.
The Astros claimed Barrosa off waivers from the Diamondbacks on Sunday.
The Mariners optioned Wisdom to Triple-A Tacoma on Sunday.
